files.source: Dhamaniya and Chandra (2017): Influence of Operating Speed on Capacity of Urban Arterial Midblock Sections
files.coverage: Twelve fitting and two validation midblocks in other Indian cities; model-estimated capacities and measured free-flow speeds, not Mumbai observations. Applicability depends on divided arterial geometry and absence of side friction.
